# FFI route-census fixture

`tiers.tsv` is the tier table the route census
(`tests/ffi_route_census.rs`, niubash#567 gate item ⑤) runs
against. It was generated by the WinuxCmd build-time generator
from the audited manifest:

- source: `unixwin/WinuxCmd` branch `feat/ffi-prototype` @ d589562
- generator: `src/ffi/generate_tiers.py`
- manifest: `src/ffi/tiers-manifest.tsv` (26 audited rows:
  10 tier-1, 8 conditional, 8 never)
- version string passed to the generator: `1.2.0-dev`
- result: 176 registered commands — 26 audited rows as above,
  the remaining 150 emitted as `tier=spawn`
  ("unclassified: R1-R7 audit pending")

The table that ships beside `winuxcore.dll` in the WinuxCmd
1.2.0 payload is regenerated by the real WinuxCmd build; this
fixture exists so the niu-side census pins the *shape* of the
contract (every name × both switch states) independent of which
DLL build is installed.

Note the audited manifest currently classifies **zero** tier-2
names — the R1–R7 audit has not assigned the tier-2 class yet —
so against this fixture the FFI claim surface is empty by data,
not by code. The census keeps the claim mechanism itself
non-vacuous with a clearly-labeled synthetic table.
